sources.title: Garrett — compressor maps
sources.verified_summary: Pressure ratio, mass flow and compressor efficiency determine matching; the number of turbos is not a power multiplier.

sources.title: Turbo Technics — hybrid performance turbo
sources.verified_summary: A preparation hybrid mixes or modifies components. It is not necessarily electric, and larger components involve response/power compromises.

sources.title: Garrett — E-Turbo
sources.verified_summary: An integrated electric motor can improve low-speed response. Energy recovery and battery management are additional systems.

sources.title: BorgWarner — boosting technologies
sources.verified_summary: Manufacturer describes wastegates, variable geometry and regulated two-stage R2S systems; those are different layouts.

sources.title: Bugatti Chiron technical specifications
sources.verified_summary: Technical specification states four turbochargers with Bugatti two-stage turbocharging and water/air intercooling.

application: Native approximate turbo assemblies, not copies of manufacturer component specifications
not_verified: Exact compressor maps, real-world part power limits, or the 3800 RPM stage threshold. Numerical tuning is game calibration.
